environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: forward /health to target group unconditionally, (2) Priority 10: a rule with condition path-pattern /api/* that has an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet-based rule that inspects QUERY_STRING with pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|xp_)` in BLOCK action with priority 1, plus a rate-based rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP at priority 2. (3) Priority 99: default action forward to target group. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs, enforced by the task's awsvpc ENI security group which allows outbound only to pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs prefix list) on port 443.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, task CPU 512, memory 1024, platform version 1.4.0
config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association on ALB ARN
config.security_group_egress: outbound 443 to pl-63a5400a only (CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint)
config.vpc: private subnets, no internet gateway, no NAT gateway
